title: Kenai Wild Fishing
specs: Fish species include King, Sockeye, Silver, Pink salmon, Rainbow Trout, Dolly Varden, Halibut
Fishing locations include Kenai River, Kasilof River, saltwater charters, and fly out trips
Custom packages available including bear viewing tours
Fishing license required for non-residents 16+ and Alaska residents 18+; king stamp required May 15 - July 31 if fishing for kings
Non-residents 15 and under and Alaska residents 17 and under require free harvest card instead of license
blurb: Guests fish for salmon and trout on the Kenai and Kasilof Rivers using guided charters. Trips include personalized service, top quality rods, reels, tackle, bait, and fish cleaning. Custom packages can include saltwater fishing and bear viewing tours.
extraNote: 50% deposit required to reserve trip; balance due 30 days prior · Failure to show up results in full charge · Rescheduling permitted within same season with 14 days advance notice and availability · Refunds with minimum 30 days notice minus 5% processing fee · Operator may cancel for safety or mechanical reasons; will try to rebook or refund minus 5% fee · Check in location varies; confirm exact location and time with guide 1-2 days before trip. · May through September
